identity.name: Frenchman's Creek
identity.notes: A 720-acre residents-only, private gated luxury beach & country club community at 13495 Tournament Drive, Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33410, with 606 single-family homes (est. 600-700 homes), two championship golf courses, a private oceanfront beach club on Juno Beach, and navigable deep-water Intracoastal canal access on select homesites. Club membership is mandatory.

fees.note: Typical range $1,500-$2,500/month; varies by property type (patio, townhome, villa, waterfront). Exact current fees require direct verification with the POA/club; some details unavailable publicly. ARB approval required for exterior modifications; rules cover shutters, irrigation, security hookups, trash, maintenance, pet breed/size limits, and rental restrictions per governing documents/ARB Manual/declarations (full details not public). Retrieved 2026-09-24T00:00:00Z, confidence 0.6 (reputable HOA/agent sources, ranges not exact).

Mandatory club membership with equity initiation fee historically around $175,000-$300,000 with partial refundability. Exact current figure requires direct verification. Retrieved 2026-09-24T00:00:00Z, confidence 0.5 (historical range, unverified current).

Annual club dues approximately $29,000-$48,000 plus minimums and capital charges. Exact current figures and any special assessments unavailable in public sources without direct verification. Retrieved 2026-09-24T00:00:00Z, confidence 0.5 (historical range, unverified current).

Median monthly HOA fee per MLS-based market analysis (195 closed sales, Jan 2020–Mar 2026); described as 3x Mirasol and 3.4x Old Marsh Golf Club. Third-party estimate, not an official HOA figure. The premium funds the concierge model, beach club, and capital reserve that funded the $90M clubhouse rebuild. Board approved an equity membership fee increase Dec 18, 2025, effective Mar 1, 2026 (per same site's membership page, unverified). Confidence 0.6 (reputable listing/analysis site). Retrieved 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z. Confidence: 0.6

Official club site: members are billed annual club dues and POA maintenance fees established by the annual operating budget. Amounts not published; club shares current schedule with applicants directly. Country club membership is mandatory for community residents. Confidence 0.9 (official HOA/club source). Retrieved 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z. Confidence: 0.9

Official club site: members pay an equity fee when a home is purchased, which includes a contribution to the Capital Reserve Fund. Equity club structure — each member owns part of the club. Amount not published. Confidence 0.9 (official HOA/club source). Retrieved 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z. Confidence: 0.9

open_questions: Exact current fee amounts: official club site states annual club dues + POA maintenance fees are set by the annual operating budget and shared directly with applicants; the $1,912/month figure is a third-party MLS-based median, not an official HOA number. Equity membership fee amount also unpublished (board approved an increase effective Mar 1, 2026 per third-party report).

Demographics: median age, median household income, and owner-occupancy % could not be extracted — the Census Reporter profile page returned only population (60,959) and area/density. No community- or ZIP-level (33410) census geography exists for the gated enclave itself.

Proximity: no verified distances. Unverified search snippets (not read/confirmed) suggest The Gardens Mall ~2 miles south and William T. Dwyer High School ~2 miles west (mapcarta.com); Jupiter Medical Center was mentioned only in a philanthropy context. Nearest hospital, library, grocery, and school distances need direct verification.
